mapper.select: select id from employee where realname = #{executor} and delmark = 1 order by id limit 1
mapper.update: update ${tableName} set ${fieldPrefix}_employee_id = #{employeeId}, ${fieldPrefix}_time = now(), ${fieldPrefix}_state = 'EXECUTING' where id = #{id} and ${fieldPrefix}_state = 'PAID'

update ${tableName} set ${fieldPrefix}_employee_id = #{employeeId}, ${inputEmployeeField} = #{employeeId}, ${fieldPrefix}_time = coalesce(str_to_date(#{executedAt}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), now()), ${fieldPrefix}_result = #{result}, ${fieldPrefix}_state = 'COMPLETED' where id = #{id} and ${fieldPrefix}_state in ('PAID', 'EXECUTING')
